meta.title: Regretting every line on a new draft withdraws an already-submitted bid
gaps: Opening a new draft from the live bid is not available as an operation.
Regretting a line is not available as an operation or field.
Re-pricing and submitting the revised bid cannot be arranged without a draft bid or regret operation.
The available read-backs do not expose bid status, revised bids, live-bid absence, or line regret state.
The setup does not expose or configure lock_quote_after_submission or price-change approval.

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event where the invited QA vendor has submitted a bid; bidding still open.
steps: As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that the read succeeds.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: the read succeeds.
